cohort: 367 obstetric patients admitted to the ICU at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Medical College, Madhya Pradesh, India, from March 2016 to August 2017
finding: Higher SOFA scores were associated with higher mortality in obstetric patients requiring ICU admission.
followup_time: The study period was from March 2016 to August 2017, but individual patient follow-up time within the ICU is not specified.
